scope: Current source-state to MakeHuman integration audit, not a mapping profile

channels.name: root_translation
channels.current_boundary: World transform translation exists; explicit meter/source-unit and coordinate-frame conversion required

channels.name: body
channels.current_boundary: Bone-local rotations exist; source labels, hierarchy, root rotation and rest-basis mapping required

channels.name: left_hand
channels.current_boundary: Finger rotations exist; actual joint correspondence, palm convention and calibration required

channels.name: right_hand
channels.current_boundary: Finger rotations exist; actual joint correspondence, palm convention and calibration required

channels.name: head_rotation
channels.current_boundary: Head bone rotation exists; source local/global/rest convention required

channels.name: head_translation
channels.current_boundary: New rest-local translations exist; source head position versus displacement, origin, axes, unit and parent convention required

channels.name: face
channels.current_boundary: Authored static controls exist; source coefficient basis, ranges and combination semantics are unbound

channels.name: left_gaze
channels.current_boundary: Eye rotation primitive exists; optical axes, vergence/torsion and source gaze frame are uncalibrated

channels.name: right_gaze
channels.current_boundary: Eye rotation primitive exists; optical axes, vergence/torsion and source gaze frame are uncalibrated

channels.name: blink
channels.current_boundary: Static lid controls exist; scalar meaning, bilateral mapping, timing and geometry coupling are unaccepted

channels.name: contact
channels.current_boundary: Crossing diagnostics exist; contact labels, surface pairs, offsets and observation/inference semantics are unbound

required_rules: Convert physical translations and coordinate frames explicitly
Resolve observed, inferred and unavailable support before rendering
Do not silently replace required unavailable channels with static bind controls
Do not interpret arbitrary source convention strings as a transformation
Do not infer gaze/blink/contact from head or body rotations without declared accepted inference
